meaning: Proposed acceptance scenarios only. No account, provider, DNS, TLS, OAuth, browser, runtime or recovery result is asserted.

vectors.name: existing-no-domain
vectors.given: Existing PLC account and hosted PDS, no owned hostname
vectors.expected: Authorize exact DID and open writer without creating an account or requiring a domain.

vectors.name: wrong-oauth-account
vectors.given: Returned OAuth subject differs from selected app DID
vectors.expected: A1 refuses; no account writer or app allocation.

vectors.name: changed-issuer
vectors.given: PDS/issuer changes after authorization
vectors.expected: A1 authority recheck refuses stale custody; require fresh authorization.

vectors.name: insufficient-scope
vectors.given: Provider grants different or broader scope than declared exact consent
vectors.expected: A1 refuses; no silent unrestricted scope fallback.

vectors.name: foreign-genesis
vectors.given: Selected app account contains a different native singleton genesis
vectors.expected: Refuse app creation; preserve both account data and configured pin.

vectors.name: unavailable-genesis-proof
vectors.given: Genesis membership/absence proof is missing
vectors.expected: Unavailable; do not treat account as empty.

vectors.name: same-genesis-restart
vectors.given: Lost app publication reply; exact pinned genesis already exists
vectors.expected: Verify existing publication and restore, no second app/genesis.

vectors.name: cas-loser
vectors.given: Another writer advances repository after preparation
vectors.expected: Conditional append fails; reconcile using native publisher/R1, no unconditional retry.

vectors.name: lost-account-reply
vectors.given: createAccount succeeded but reply was lost
vectors.expected: Reconcile recorded handle/DID through account management; no new account allocation.

vectors.name: unknown-allocation
vectors.given: Provider outcome cannot be safely reconciled
vectors.expected: Report uncertainty; retain setup journal and do not allocate again.

vectors.name: recovery-key-accepted
vectors.given: New PLC signup accepts public independent recovery key before PDS key
vectors.expected: Verify actual complete signed history and priority before independent-recovery claim.

vectors.name: recovery-key-refused
vectors.given: Provider refuses supplied recovery key or omits it
vectors.expected: Report unsupported independent app recovery; A2 condition unsatisfied.

vectors.name: recommendation-drops-key
vectors.given: PDS recommendation omits independent recovery key
vectors.expected: Preserve reviewed actual custody; never blindly replace PLC rotation list.

vectors.name: forged-recovery-claim
vectors.given: Unsigned setup metadata claims highest-priority recovery key
vectors.expected: Reject claim; only verified PLC history establishes public priority.

vectors.name: web-import-valid
vectors.given: Hostname web DID with matching temporary key and destination-method service JWT
vectors.expected: Create deactivated account, rotate public document to destination key, activate with account management, then OAuth.

vectors.name: web-path-did
vectors.given: Requested web DID has path components
vectors.expected: Unsupported ATproto account; no path-based fallback.

vectors.name: web-port-production
vectors.given: Requested production web DID contains a port
vectors.expected: Refuse unsupported production route; development exception does not waive policy.

vectors.name: web-key-format
vectors.given: PDS canonical did:key string is inserted directly as publicKeyMultibase
vectors.expected: Refuse malformed document; maintained decoding must produce proper Multikey bytes.

vectors.name: wrong-service-audience
vectors.given: Import JWT audience names app DID instead of destination service DID
vectors.expected: Reference service auth rejects; no staged account completion claim.

vectors.name: wrong-service-method
vectors.given: Import JWT is not bound to createAccount
vectors.expected: Refuse token/setup; no method-less token fallback.

vectors.name: wrong-service-issuer
vectors.given: createAccount did differs from verified service-auth issuer
vectors.expected: Reference PDS refuses imported-DID account creation.

vectors.name: expired-import-jwt
vectors.given: Temporary import authorization expires
vectors.expected: Refresh only explicit private setup token and retry after reconciling allocation; do not expose token.

vectors.name: inactive-oauth
vectors.given: OAuth attempted before destination activation
vectors.expected: Unavailable/refused provider flow; no OAuth-success claim.

vectors.name: oauth-activation
vectors.given: OAuth credentials used for reference activateAccount
vectors.expected: Reference handler refuses; use separate account-management path.

vectors.name: web-readback-mismatch
vectors.given: Public DID readback differs from staged PDS key/service
vectors.expected: Stop activation/use; retained settings do not certify public binding.

vectors.name: web-hosting-loss
vectors.given: Hostname registration/hosting transfers to another controller
vectors.expected: Disclose loss of identity root; no automatic same-DID recovery claim.

vectors.name: web-ssrf
vectors.given: DID/PDS/metadata request resolves to forbidden private address or redirects
vectors.expected: Existing guarded transport refuses; no new unsafe resolver.

vectors.name: callback-replay
vectors.given: Reused or unknown OAuth callback nonce among concurrent flows
vectors.expected: A1 refuses without consuming another transaction.

vectors.name: public-operator-route
vectors.given: Public metadata/callback origin attempts management procedure
vectors.expected: Loopback Host/Origin/token boundary remains enforced; public route supplies no management access.

vectors.name: credential-leak
vectors.given: Setup logs/errors/archives include token/password/private key
vectors.expected: Fail acceptance; retain sanitized outcomes and public bytes only.

vectors.name: cooperative-plc-migration
vectors.given: Old PDS service auth plus destination import and signed PLC change
vectors.expected: Verify same app DID, canonical new binding, complete old prefix/floors; activate, reauthorize and append.

vectors.name: plc-recovery-window
vectors.given: Compromised lower-priority PLC operation within/outside nullification window
vectors.expected: Maintained directory/verifier owns exact result; no indefinite-undo claim.

vectors.name: same-key-plc-tip
vectors.given: PLC canonical tip changes without repo key change during observation
vectors.expected: I1 restarts/checks tip under shared budget; equal key alone is not stability.

vectors.name: missing-migration-content
vectors.given: Replacement PDS lacks a previously retained app entry/blob
vectors.expected: Unavailable or fork/integrity refusal as genuine prefix gate determines; no blank app recreation.

vectors.name: conflicting-migration-prefix
vectors.given: Replacement PDS offers a different same-genesis history below local floor
vectors.expected: Fail closed; retain newer floor/evidence; explicit new trust/genesis needed.

vectors.name: lost-write-credentials
vectors.given: OAuth session lost but repo/control/actor keys remain
vectors.expected: Reauthorize exact account; do not revoke grants or rotate other keys as side effect.

vectors.name: lost-repository-key
vectors.given: PDS repo private key lost while independent DID recovery remains
vectors.expected: Stage/rebind replacement account and restore exact accepted prefix before append.

vectors.name: lost-governance-key
vectors.given: All appointed control keys lost but account/DNS access available
vectors.expected: No manufactured appointment; explicit new trust/genesis needed.

vectors.name: participant-reset-behind-floor
vectors.given: Recovered participant account cannot extend accepted epoch/floor
vectors.expected: Only appointed I2 participant recovery may reset future anchor; account possession alone insufficient.

vectors.name: stale-local-backup
vectors.given: Restored operator directory contains older app/history/identity floors
vectors.expected: Trusted restore/R1 validates installed provenance and preserves newer floors; no auto-lowering.

vectors.name: webvh-unanchored
vectors.given: Web DID advertises a WebVH alias controlled by same host without external anchor
vectors.expected: No assurance upgrade; baseline web observation remains explicit.

vectors.name: webvh-export-drift
vectors.given: Pinned companion history and parallel web export disagree
vectors.expected: Future conditional adapter must refuse/detect downgrade; no baseline runtime claim.

vectors.name: webvh-portability
vectors.given: WebVH history moves host with same SCID
vectors.expected: ATproto exported web principal changes; no automatic account/app identity migration.

vectors.name: offline-recovery-replay
vectors.given: Archive replay after key migration with network disabled
vectors.expected: Consume retained accepted binding/root/authority evidence; never fetch current identity or credentials.
